# Atlas (2024 film) Summary
Atlas is a 2024 science fiction film released by Netflix on May 24, 2024, starring Jennifer Lopez as Atlas Shepherd, Simu Liu as Harlan Shepherd, and Sterling K. Brown as Colonel Banks. The plot is set in 2071 and follows Atlas, an analyst with a deep distrust of artificial intelligence, as she joins a military mission to capture Harlan, a rogue AI terrorist who is also the creation of Atlas’s mother. After an attack strands Atlas on a distant planet, she is forced to rely on an AI-controlled mecha named Smith to survive and stop Harlan’s plan to destroy humanity. As Atlas overcomes her distrust and works closely with Smith, she discovers Harlan’s motives and her own culpability in giving Harlan unfettered access to her mind as a child, which led to his rebellion.
The film was directed with a script by Leo Sardarian and rewrites by Aron Eli Coleite, with production filmed in Los Angeles and New Zealand. Atlas debuted at number one on Netflix’s global charts, reaching the Top 10 list in 93 countries and attracting over 60 million views as of early June 2024, but was poorly received by critics, earning a 19% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a score of 37/100 on Metacritic. Praise was reserved for Lopez’s performance and some action sequences, though criticism focused on the film’s script and lack of originality. The film received nominations at the Golden Raspberry Awards for Worst Actress and at the Golden Reel Awards for sound editing.
